hero.desc: Based in Surabaya, Indonesia, I'm a Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist combining Meta Ads, Creative Strategy, and Information Systems. I run two business lines in parallel — ISO/NSM certification for institutions and IWASH cleaning service for consumers — centered on cost-efficient audience testing, high-intent WhatsApp consultation funnels, and closing high-value contracts.
hero.trust: Real 2025–2026 Meta Ads evidence across two business lines, with a verified closing track record.

chart_section.title: Sales Revenue Generated via Meta Ads
chart_section.desc: Monthly comparison between paid advertising expenditure (Ad Spend) and finalized transaction value (Revenue). Use the business-line and period filters at the top of the page to inspect each line separately.
chart_section.takeaway_body: 2026 marked a major step up: ISO/NSM revenue reached Rp 146.18M at 30.9x ROAS. December 2026 delivered the single largest deal at Rp 42.18M from only Rp 500K of ad spend. Meanwhile IWASH proved seasonal campaigns still pay — Lunar New Year returned the highest ROAS at 9.5x on an Rp 88K budget.
